merge_basis: Candidate T0013 concerns Zongertinib in Breast Cancer 2L Phase 3 (Beamion Breast-2, study 1479-0017), which is a distinct indication and study from all existing groups: G0005 covers Zongertinib 1L NSCLC NDA, and G0011 covers a Zongertinib IIS NSCLC China study. Different indication (BC vs NSCLC), different study number, and different development stage; no existing group matches.
